# infisical_pam_account_windows_ad (Resource)

Create and manage Windows Active Directory accounts in Infisical PAM. The connection is tested when the account is created or its connection changes. Sessions only launch if the template records to S3: `settings.recording` needs `storage_backend = "aws-s3"`, `connection_id` and `s3`. Only Machine Identity authentication is supported for this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

data "infisical_gateway" "main" {
  name = "prod-gateway"
}

resource "infisical_pam_folder" "windows_team" {
  name = "windows-team"
}

# Windows AD sessions only launch when the template records to S3.
resource "infisical_pam_account_template" "windows_ad" {
  name         = "windows-ad-default"
  account_type = "windows-ad"
  gateway_id   = data.infisical_gateway.main.id

  settings = {
    recording = {
      storage_backend = "aws-s3"
      connection_id   = "<aws-app-connection-id>"
      s3 = {
        bucket     = "acme-pam-recordings"
        region     = "us-east-1"
        key_prefix = "windows/"
      }
    }
  }
}

resource "infisical_pam_account_windows_ad" "pamadmin" {
  name        = "corp-pamadmin"
  folder_id   = infisical_pam_folder.windows_team.id
  template_id = infisical_pam_account_template.windows_ad.id

  connection_details = {
    domain     = "corp.example.com"
    dc_address = "dc01.corp.example.com"
    hosts      = ["ws01.corp.example.com", "ws02.corp.example.com"]
  }

  credentials = {
    username = "CORP\\pamadmin"
    password = var.pamadmin_password
  }

  rotation_account_id = "self"
}

variable "pamadmin_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connection_details` (Attributes) How to reach the Windows Active Directory target. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_details))
- `credentials` (Attributes) The credentials of the account. Secrets are never read back, so changes made outside of Terraform, such as rotation, aren't detected. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))
- `folder_id` (String) The ID of the folder the account is in. Changing it moves the account.
- `name` (String) The name of the account, unique in its folder. Must be lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, at most 64 characters.
- `template_id` (String) The ID of the account template the account uses, which must be a `windows-ad` template.

### Optional

- `description` (String) An optional description of the account.
- `gateway_id` (String) The ID of the gateway to connect through instead of the template's.
- `gateway_pool_id` (String) The ID of the gateway pool to connect through instead of the template's.
- `rotation_account_id` (String) The ID of another account of the same type and target that rotates this account's password, or `self` for the account to rotate its own. Rotation is enabled on the template.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the account.

<a id="nestedatt--connection_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connection_details`

Required:

- `dc_address` (String) The hostname or IP address of a domain controller, used for LDAP connections.
- `domain` (String) The fully qualified domain name of the Active Directory domain, e.g. corp.example.com.
- `hosts` (List of String) The hostnames or IP addresses the account may open sessions to.

Optional:

- `ldap_ca_cert` (String) The PEM-encoded CA certificate to verify the domain controller with over LDAPS.
- `ldap_port` (Number) The LDAP port of the domain controller. Defaults to 389.
- `ldap_reject_unauthorized` (Boolean) Whether to reject a domain controller certificate that isn't trusted. Defaults to true.
- `ldap_tls_server_name` (String) The server name to verify the domain controller's certificate against over LDAPS.
- `rdp_port` (Number) The RDP port of the hosts. Defaults to 3389.
- `use_ldaps` (Boolean) Whether to connect to the domain controller over LDAPS. Defaults to false.
- `use_winrm_https` (Boolean) Whether to use WinRM over HTTPS. Defaults to false.
- `winrm_ca_cert` (String) The PEM-encoded CA certificate to verify WinRM over HTTPS with.
- `winrm_port` (Number) The WinRM port of the hosts, used for credential rotation. Defaults to 5985.
- `winrm_reject_unauthorized` (Boolean) Whether to reject a WinRM certificate that isn't trusted. Defaults to true.


<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Required:

- `username` (String) The domain user, in DOMAIN\username form (e.g. CORP\Administrator).

Optional:

- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password of the domain user.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# This will import the Windows Active Directory PAM account by its ID.
# Secrets are never read back, so set the credentials in the configuration after importing.
terraform import infisical_pam_account_windows_ad.example <account_id>
```
